result_access_at_freeze: No C009 official-backbone full-training or evaluation results existed. Prior C006/C007 negative and mixed results remain mandatory context.

analysis_unit.synthetic_optical: physical parent/condition after averaging crops and seed-matched predictions
analysis_unit.external_crack: physical parent nested in tunnel; tiles are computational units only
analysis_unit.d3_field: camera-region-direction acquisition cell; frames are not independent specimens
analysis_unit.width: nominal width nested in acquisition condition and source frame

uncertainty.bootstrap: parent-within-tunnel hierarchical bootstrap, 10000 replicates, frozen seed 20260924
uncertainty.permutation: exact paired parent permutation when feasible; otherwise 100000 sign-flip permutations with frozen seed 20260924
uncertainty.multiplicity: Holm correction at familywise alpha 0.05 for the three individual-backbone claims and separately for the three independent-detector claims; macro-primary tests are single tests
uncertainty.missingness: no imputation; report eligible, failed, and non-estimable counts and reasons

optical.comparison_primary: MERIT full package minus base package within the same official backbone, seed, parent, and degradation

restoration_efficacy_floor.comparison: MERIT full package minus degraded input

backbone_portability_pass.interpretation_on_failure: architecture-dependent mixed effect; no backbone-portable MERIT claim

identity_safety.input: zero synthetic degradation with zero prompt
identity_safety.failure_rule: any official backbone failure blocks a global safety claim

oversharpening_safety.comparison: absolute gradient magnitude error to clean reference
oversharpening_safety.ringing_check: edge-normal overshoot p95 cannot increase by more than 0.01 on the [0,1] intensity scale

estimator_gate.rule: if either gate fails, MTF is descriptive only and cannot decide restoration efficacy

efficacy_when_gate_passes.comparison: absolute MTF50 error of MERIT minus degraded

crack.primary: AUPRC delta, MERIT full package minus degraded, within detector and parent

detector_consistency.legacy_deepcrack_role: reported separately; cannot rescue the independent-panel gate

matched_sensitivity_safety.target: raw/degraded reference sensitivity frozen before C009 evaluation
matched_sensitivity_safety.language: detector burden only unless a physical negative reference exists

crack.failure_rule: thresholded F1, subgroup selection, or a single detector cannot rescue an AUPRC gate failure

primary.comparison: correct prompt minus zero prompt on the same frozen NAFNet checkpoint family

dose_response.metric: Spearman correlation between absolute prompt error and optical error

prompt_reliance.claim_limit: synthetic oracle-prompt reliance only; not an operational prompt-estimation claim

architecture.comparison: cascade or parallel minus single, same package and exposure
architecture.failure_rule: report no additional improvement in the tested setting; do not select the better arm after results without reporting both

printed_width.target: image-visible CAD printed nominal apparent widths 0.1 to 1.0 mm
printed_width.precondition: the per-image 10-ROI ledger and local pixel/mm transform pass independent review before any width outcome is computed

primary_pass.comparison: absolute nominal-width error of MERIT minus controlled degraded
primary_pass.nominal_widths_with_improved_point_estim: 7 of 10; if 0.1 and 0.2 mm are both predeclared non-estimable, 6 of the remaining 8

increment_over_base.comparison: absolute nominal-width error of MERIT minus base

non_estimable_safety.subpixel_rule: never force a numeric width when fit uncertainty spans more than half the nominal width or the fitted edge pair is unresolved

printed_width.claim_limit: does not establish natural-crack physical width accuracy

ood.per_family_breaking_point: first severity at which the optical macro-primary or identity/oversharpening safety gate fails
ood.family_level_success: severity 1 and 2 both pass optical macro-primary and safety gates
ood.broad_six_family_claim: all 6 families pass severity 1 and 2, and at least 4 of 6 pass severity 3
ood.crack_endpoint: reported separately and must pass the crack macro gate; optical success cannot substitute for crack success

global_verdict.full_merit_supported: optical, backbone portability, prompt reliance, identity/oversharpening safety, external crack, and width primary gates all pass
global_verdict.optical_only: optical and safety pass but external crack or width fails
global_verdict.architecture_dependent: optical macro passes but backbone portability fails
global_verdict.not_supported: optical macro or identity/oversharpening safety fails
global_verdict.mandatory_reporting: all predeclared arms, seeds, detectors, tunnels, severities, non-estimable cases, and prior negative C006/C007 results

hard_stop_conditions: source, cohort, split, protocol, or official-code hash mismatch
external D2 or D3 outcomes used for training, checkpoint selection, threshold selection, or hyperparameter tuning
non-finite loss that cannot be reproduced as a documented implementation failure
missing seed or partial run presented as a completed comparison
post-result relaxation of any numeric gate without labeling the changed analysis exploratory
